payload.text: player.html carries no brand token, and the check covers STRING LITERALS in JS as well as CSS custom properties. Red-proved against the known live instance: player.html:613 is 'add("Producer", REEL.producer || "Snorkeltoast")', a hardcoded brand name in the shell README section 28 says knows about no brand. HOIST.md section 4's proposed guard, grep for '--pop-', returns ZERO hits against it -- verified 2026-09-09 -- because it was written from the one instance that had been found, a CSS custom property, and so catches that instance rather than the class. The check applies to player.html and showreel and NOT to themes/, whose brand strings are legitimate.
